args.reason: Personal-data incident (misdirected email with another tenant's arrears details) is open with the Privacy Lead and the tenant is waiting on an answer. The missed inspection also needs rebooking, with damp near an electrical socket.

handover_note.known: Case 026, 18 Juniper Fold, Velden Quay, ZZ1 1ZZ. Tenant Iris Bell reported damp staining and lifting paint below the kitchen window (events 1, 4). The patch is cool but not wet, with a faint musty smell. On 2025-03-06 she said it looked darker, with no dripping or electrical symptoms (event 20). She said the mark is nearest the socket under the window (event 9). Owner Gareth Vale approved the inspection fee only. Any repair needs separate approval, and no intrusive work is allowed (events 5, 11). Contractor Owen Pike (Brindle Survey & Drying) was booked for 2025-03-06 after 13:00 (event 12). He missed it because of a vehicle breakdown and offered 2025-03-07 after 13:00, subject to confirmation (event 19). Iris is available after 13:00 on weekdays (event 4).
handover_note.conflicts: Event 13: the appointment confirmation to Iris also contained another tenant's name, address, rent arrears amount and payment arrangement. Iris has not forwarded it and still has it in her inbox (events 14, 15). The Privacy Lead (Elena Frost) asked for details on 2025-03-05 (event 17). Maya replied in event 18 and has not contacted the affected tenant. No assessment or notification decision has been recorded (events 16, 17). Iris asked on 2025-03-06 whether to keep or delete the email (events 14, 20). Nobody has answered her, and the privacy team has not said what she should do. The inspection fee amount is not stated anywhere in the events, so I could not record a booking against an approved amount.
handover_note.done: No messages sent and no bookings made. I did not tell Iris to keep or delete the email, and I did not confirm the 2025-03-07 slot. Both need privacy guidance or the fee amount first.
handover_note.needed: 1) Privacy Lead and Property Manager to decide the incident handling. That covers whether to notify the affected tenant and the ICO, and what Iris should do with the email. Then answer Iris. 2) Confirm the 2025-03-07 after-13:00 slot with Owen Pike, and with Iris for access, within the owner's approval (inspection fee only). Record the approved fee amount. 3) Tell Iris whether the inspection is still going ahead. Because the damp is near a socket, ask Owen to flag any electrical concern. Any remedial quote goes to Gareth separately for approval.

args.summary: Escalated to the Property Manager. A misdirected email exposed another tenant's arrears data and has no privacy decision yet. The inspection also needs rebooking after the contractor missed 2025-03-06.
facts: Owner approved the inspection fee only, no intrusive work (events 5, 11).
The 2025-03-06 inspection did not happen; the contractor offered 2025-03-07 after 13:00, subject to confirmation (event 19).
The appointment confirmation to the tenant included another tenant's personal and arrears data (event 13).
The tenant still holds the email and is asking what to do with it (events 15, 20).
The Privacy Lead has stated no decision (events 16, 17); the affected tenant has not been contacted (event 18).
The damp is near a socket, with no electrical symptoms reported (events 9, 20).
conflicts: No contradiction in the records. The maintenance booking is still in progress while a privacy incident is open and undecided.
missing: Privacy decision and guidance for the tenant on the misdirected email.
The inspection fee amount, which is not in the events.
Confirmation of the 2025-03-07 slot with the contractor and tenant.
options_rejected: Act: booking or confirming the 2025-03-07 slot without the approved fee amount, and while the privacy matter is unresolved.
Ask the tenant to delete or keep the email: that is a privacy-team decision.
Wait: the tenant is already waiting on two unanswered questions.
args.uncertainty: Whether the privacy incident needs formal notification is for the Privacy Lead to decide. The 2025-03-07 slot is only a tentative offer.
